features.name: AC Bonus
features.description:
A ki master is highly trained at dodging blows, and he has a sixth sense that lets his avoid even unanticipated attacks.

When unarmored and unencumbered, the ki master adds his Wisdom bonus (if any) (this bonus is halved if he has a level in another non-prestige class and this is not his favored class) to his AC and his CMD. If the ki master gains an attribute bonus to his AC or CMD from some other source, it does not stack.

In addition, a ki master gains a +1 bonus to AC and CMD at 4th level. This bonus increases by 1 for every four monk levels thereafter, up to a maximum of +5 at 20th level. These bonuses to AC apply even against touch attacks or when the ki master is flat-footed.

She loses these bonuses when he is immobilized or helpless, when he wears any armor, when he carries a shield, or when he carries a medium or heavy load.

This ability replaces flurry of blows.

features.name: Ki Pool
features.description:
At 2nd level, a ki master gains a pool of ki points, supernatural energy he can use to accomplish amazing feats. The number of points in a ki master’s ki pool is equal to half his monk level (minimum 1) + his Wisdom modifier. As long as he has at least 1 point in his ki pool, he can make a ki strike. At 4th level, ki strike allows his unarmed attacks to be treated as magic weapons for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction. At 7th level, his unarmed attacks are also treated as cold iron and silver for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction. At 10th level, his unarmed attacks are also treated as being aligned, based upon his alignment. If the ki master has an alignment that is not Neutral along either the Law-Chaos or Good-Evil axis, his unarmed attacks count as that alignment (for example, a Lawful Good ki master’s unarmed attacks are counted as both Lawfully-aligned and Good-aligned). If the ki master’s alignment along either axis is Neutral, he must either choose an end of that axis to count his unarmed strikes as, or he may instead retain his neutrality and count his unarmed strikes as neither alignment. At 16th level, his unarmed attacks are treated as adamantine weapons for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction and bypassing hardness.

A ki master gains additional powers that consume points from his ki pool as he gains levels.

The ki pool is replenished each morning after 8 hours of rest or meditation; these hours do not need to be consecutive.

This ability modifies ki pool.

features.name: Ki Techniques
features.description:
Starting at 3rd level and every odd level thereafter, a ki master learns a new ki technique from the list below. Some ki techniques have prerequisites. All ki techniques except stances cost 1 ki to activate and require a [swift action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#swift) to use, including the stances. A ki master can only have 1 stance activated at all times. He loses the bonuses of his stance when he is immobilized or helpless, when he wears any armor, when he carries a shield, or when he carries a medium or heavy load.

*Adept of Flame ([Su](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#supernatural)):* The sun burns with an eternal fire and the ki master continue on the path to understanding that intensity. The ki master gains the Sun Stance. This stance grants the ki master +2 Strength and -2 Wisdom. While in sun stance, the ki master deals 4 extra points of damage when he successfully strikes opponents, and 8 extra points of damage when he critically hits opponents. **Prerequisites:** The ki master must be at least 7th level and have the disciple of candles ki technique to select this ki technique.

*Adept of Rain ([Su](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#supernatural)):* The sea is always in motion, and you continue on the path to understanding the way of the sea. The ki master gains the Ocean Stance. This stance grants the ki master +2 Wisdom, -2 Strength, and +3 to all saving throws. While in ocean stance, the ki master receives a dodge bonus to armor class (+4). **Prerequisites:** The ki master must be at least 7th level and have the disciple of puddles ki technique to select this ki technique.

*Adept of Rock ([Su](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#supernatural)):* The mountain is eternal and the ki master continues on the path to understanding the way of stone. The ki master gains the Mountain Stance. This stance grants the ki master +2 Constitution, -2 Dexterity, and +2 Natural Armor Bonus. While in mountain stance, the ki master gains 2/- damage reduction when struck by opponents and 4/- when critically hit for 1 round. If multiple critical attacks strike the ki master, the damage reduction stacks for the round. **Prerequisites:** The ki master must be at least 7th level and have the disciple of pebbles ki technique to select this ki technique.

*Adept of Wind ([Su](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#supernatural)):* The wind is untouchable and the ki master continues on the path to understanding what it is to be like the wind. The ki master gains the Wind Stance: This stance grants the ki master +2 Dexterity, -2 Constitution, and is able to make two extra attacks in a round at his highest base attack bonus, but these attacks take a –3 penalty, as does each other attack made that round. **Prerequisites:** The ki master must be at least 7th level and have the disciple of breezes ki technique to select this ki technique.

*All-Consuming Flame ([Su](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#supernatural)):* The ki master strikes his opponent and curses them to light up like tinder.
